data.name: Aakifah
data.gender_notes: Aakifah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman who cultivates, grows, and nurtures. The name Aakifah carries the meaning “Grower, Cultivator” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aakifah usually hope their child will grow to embody grower, cultivator and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A soul that nurtures and grows other souls.
data.etymology: Aakifah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grower, Cultivator.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aakifah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عاكفة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عربي مؤنث يعني المتفرغة في العبادة، الملتصقة بالمساجد، والمقصود بها الانعزال عن الدنيا و الانكفاء على العبادة وطاعة الله، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران: وَمَا أَفْعَلُ بِالَّذِينَ أُتِينَ الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا أَمْنًا أَوْ خَوْفًا

in_urdu.name: عاکفہ
in_urdu.meaning: عبادت میں مصروف، مساجد سے منسلک
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی زبان کا ایک مؤنث نام جس کا مطلب ہے عبادت میں مصروف، مساجد سے منسلک، جو دنیا سے الگ تھلگ ہو کر صرف عبادت و طاعت الٰہی میں مشغول رہتی ہے، جیسا کہ قرآن مجید آل عمران کی سورۃ میں آیا ہے: وَمَا أَفْعَلُ بِالَّذِينَ أُتِينَ الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا أَمْنًا أَوْ خَوْفًا

in_hindi.name: आकिफा
in_hindi.meaning: पूजा-पाठ में लीन, मस्जिद से जुड़ी
in_hindi.long_meaning: आकिफा एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है पूजा-पाठ में लीन, मस्जिद से जुड़ी, दुनिया से अलग होकर केवल इबादत और अल्लाह की तौहीद में मशगूल रहना, जैसा कि कुरआन में कहा गया है: وَمَا أَفْعَلُ بِالَّذِينَ أُتِينَ الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا أَمْنًا أَوْ خَوْفًا

in_pashto.name: عاکفه
in_pashto.meaning: د عبادت ځانګړې شوې، په مسجدو پورې تړلې
in_pashto.long_meaning: عاکفه د عربي ژبې يوه ښځينه نوم دی چې مانا يې د عبادت ځانګړې شوې، په مسجدو پورې تړلې، د دنيا څخه يې جلا کړي دي، يوازې د عبادت او د الله تعالی د پيروۍ لپاره ځانګړې شوې، لکه څنګه چې په قرآن کريم کې يې راغلي: وَمَا أَفْعَلُ بِالَّذِينَ أُتِينَ الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا أَمْنًا أَوْ خَوْفًا

in_english.name: Aakifah
in_english.meaning: One who is devoted to worship, attached to mosques
in_english.long_meaning: Aakifah is a beautiful and meaningful name derived from Arabic roots, signifying one who is devoted to worship, attached to mosques, and dedicated to spiritual growth. Etymologically linked to the Arabic term 'aakif', meaning 'one who stays' or 'dwells', Aakifah connotes a sense of dedication, piety, and spiritual inclination. Historically, the name Aakifah has been used to describe individuals, particularly women, who lead a life of devotion, prayer, and contemplation. The Quranic reference in Surah Aal-e-Imraan (3:186) highlights the significance of remaining steadfast in faith. Aakifah symbolizes a personality that values spirituality, humility, and submission to the divine.

As we go through life, we are all individually and collectively under His watchful care and guidance. Just as a mother tenderly nurtures her child, Allah (SWT) cares for us with love and patience. The name "Aakifah" is a reminder of this divine grace and blessings. It encourages us to trust in Allah's plan for us and to strive towards personal and spiritual growth, knowing that with His help, we too can cultivate a beautiful and meaningful life.
